citations.title: Bizagi Launches AI Advisor to Help Enterprises Stop Guessing Where AI Agents Belong
excerpts: # Bizagi Launches AI Advisor to Help Enterprises Stop Guessing Where AI Agents Belong

## New AI-driven discovery capability shows the business impact first, giving customers a personalized, ranked view of where AI Agents will make the biggest difference and the agentic redesign to get there

November 5 2026, WASHINGTON D.C. Bizagi, the enterprise process orchestration company, today announced [Bizagi AI Advisor](https://www.bizagi.com/pt/home/platform/platform-features/ai-advisor.html "Bizagi AI Advisor | AI-Driven Discovery for Your Processes") , an AI-driven discovery tool that produces a personalized, ranked list of where AI can make the biggest difference to a customer's business today. Built into Bizagi Monitoring Center, AI Advisor analyzes how the processes customers run in Bizagi actually perform, identifies the tasks with the greatest potential, and suggests how [AI Agents](https://www.bizagi.com/pt/plataforma/agentes-de-ia "AI Agents | Bizagi") could redesign them.

basis.reasoning: Bizagi’s dated announcement states it launched AI Advisor on November 5, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.
